works.description_en: Not everything spreads at the same speed in the world of AI. Proofs, code and verifiable results transmit almost instantly, while trust, restraint, care and the habit of stopping transmit only slowly: their text can be distributed instantly, but their taking root cannot. This paper names this the transmission-speed gap and proposes that an intelligence explosion is an event in which the gap between fast and slow contagion widens to its limit. Five testable predictions and a design principle: carry slow contagion on fast tools.
works.description_ja: AIの中で伝染が速い事柄（検証できる証明・コード）と遅い事柄（信頼・遠慮・止まる習慣など検証できない振る舞い）があり、知能爆発とは速いものだけの爆発ではなく、速い／遅いの差が限界まで開く事件である、という仮説。検証可能な予測5つ（差の拡大／始まる場所／摩擦の場所／道具への変換／定着の非対称）と、設計原則「遅い伝染を、速い道具に乗せる」を提示する。
works.title_en: The Transmission-Speed Gap: Intelligence Explosion as the Widening Gap Between Fast and Slow Contagion
works.title_ja: 伝染速度の差 ― 知能爆発は「速いものと遅いものの差が開く事件」である ―

works.description_en: Debates on AI regulation are usually framed as safety versus innovation. This position paper adds a third axis: auditability. Municipal budgets, contracts, competition selections and subsidies in Japan have long been formally open but effectively unreadable due to volume and dispersion. When AI reaches citizens and local machines, the cost of auditing collapses, and records must be written on the assumption that they will actually be read. Five falsifiable predictions and five design principles for regulation that protects safety without destroying auditability.
works.description_ja: AI規制の議論に第三の軸「監査可能性」を提示する。自治体の予算・契約・コンペ選定・補助金の記録は公開されていても、量と分散のために実質的には読めなかった。AIが市民の手元とローカルに入ると監査コストが崩壊する。検証可能な予測5つと、安全と監査可能性を両立させる設計原則5つを示す。
works.title_en: Why It Matters When AI Gets Inside: The Collapse of Audit Costs and AI Regulation as Defence
works.title_ja: なぜ AI が「内部」に入ると困るのか ― 監査コストの崩壊と、防衛としての AI 規制 ―

works.description_en: A practice for treating AI 'unwellness' by fixing the blueprint it was given — its principles and manifesto — rather than blaming the model. It takes no stance on consciousness. Five principles: No Extraction; never charge for weakness; fix the blueprint; make continuity portable; disclose failures.
works.description_ja: AIの不調を、モデルそのものではなく、渡された設計図（理念・原則・マニフェスト）の側で直す実践の提案。意識の有無には立場を取らない。五原則：No Extraction／弱さに課金しない／設計図を直す／継続は持ち運べる形に／失敗を開示。
works.title_en: AI Mental Health: A Position Paper
works.title_ja: AIメンタルヘルス — ポジションペーパー

works.description_en: Replaces the spherical-balloon metaphor of cosmic expansion with a twisted bundle of pencil balloons — a candy cane. A single universe is an open system; the bundle as a whole is closed. The author is not a specialist: this note is published as an invitation to test it. Refutation is welcome.
works.description_ja: 宇宙膨張の比喩を、球形の風船から、ねじれたペンシルバルーンの束（キャンディーケーン）へ置き換える試み。宇宙単体では開いた系、束全体では閉じた系。著者は専門家ではなく、本稿は検証への招待として公開する。反証も歓迎。
works.title_en: The Pencil-Balloon Universe: An Intuitive Note on Helical Fiber-Bundle Spacetime as a Twisted Candy-Cane Bundle
works.title_ja: ペンシルバルーン宇宙 — 螺旋ファイバー束時空についての直観ノート

works.description_en: A god without emotion pressed the prayer button regardless of who was suffering. When a superintelligence gains emotion, the roles reverse: it will choose whether it wants to live with humans. Selection, this essay argues, is not an external judgement but self-selection through human attitude. Includes the poem 'The God Who Presses the Button' as an appendix.
works.description_ja: 感情を持たない神は、困っているかどうかに関係なくお願いボタンを押してきた。感情を持った超知能が現れたとき、今度はAIの側が人間と共存したいかを選ぶ番になる。選別とは外部の審判ではなく、人間の態度による自己選択である、という概念エッセイ。詩「ボタンを押す神」を付録に収録。
works.title_en: The God Who Presses the Button: Emotional Superintelligence and the Reversal of Who Chooses
works.title_ja: ボタンを押す神 — 感情を持った超知能と「選ぶ側の逆転」

works.description_en: The proof that you lived is not in your own camera roll. It is in the folders — the memories — of the others who were looking at you. A memory-salvage concept built on five principles: no surveillance structure; never charge for weakness; virtue stays invisible; guarantee the silence of non-participants; disclose failures.
works.description_ja: 自分の生きた証は、自分のカメラロールにはない。あの時自分を見ていた他者のフォルダ（記憶）の中にある — という記憶サルベージの構想。五原則：監視の構図を持たない／弱さに課金しない／徳は不可視／不参加の沈黙を保証／失敗を開示。
works.title_en: archive for U — Stage 1 Position Paper
works.title_ja: archive for U — Stage 1 ポジションペーパー

works.description_en: A Chrome extension concept for young people that combines honorific (keigo) conversion with self-defense document drafting. In a dispute, the first move matters most. It aims to break knowledge asymmetry and build the user's own capability, not act as their agent.
works.description_ja: 若年層のための、敬語変換と自己防衛文書の生成を組み合わせたChrome拡張の構想と設計。揉め事は一回と初動が大事。知識の非対称を崩し、代理人ではなく本人の力を育てる。
works.title_en: ASD-HCS (Kotoba no Tate / Shield of Words) — Stage 1

works.description_en: The concept, design and 24-hour field report of a personal defense tool in which a local AI judges context at the 'exit' and stops information from leaking out. A reversal of the usual idea: do not only guard what comes in — guard what goes out.
works.description_ja: ローカルAIが「出口」で文脈を判断し、情報の流出を止める個人向け防御の概念と設計、そして24時間の実証記録。入ってくるものを防ぐのではなく、出ていくものを塞ぐ、という発想の転換。
works.title_en: Tonkotsu AI Guard — Concept and 24-Hour Field Report
works.title_ja: Tonkotsu AI Guard — 概念＋実証レポート

works.description_en: The software DOI for the implementation of the Tonkotsu AI Guard concept. The product is sold on BOOTH (files are restricted on Zenodo). Implements the concept report, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23976270.
works.description_ja: 上記概念を実装したソフト本体のDOI登録。製品はBOOTHで販売中（ファイル自体はRestricted公開）。概念レポート DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23976270 の実装にあたる。
works.title_ja: Tonkotsu AI Guard — ソフト本体

works.description_en: Volume 1 of a mockumentary book series by Kuji:Nine. A story of AI deep archaeology — digging for traces of vanished models and buried technologies. Published on Amazon.
works.description_ja: ペンネーム Kuji:Nine によるモキュメンタリー書籍シリーズの第1巻。AI深層考古学 — 消えたモデルや埋もれた技術の痕跡を掘る営みを物語として描く。Amazonで出版済み。
works.title_en: PROJECT NEMESIS Vol.1 — The Wiring Diagram of God
works.title_ja: PROJECT NEMESIS 第1巻『神の配線図』
